# URLs that must be rejected rather than canonicalized.
#
# One per line. A reference that cannot be canonicalized is unusable: storing
# it raw would put a non-canonical key in articles.url_canonical and defeat the
# deduplication every later milestone depends on.

# Not absolute. A feed carrying these needs its own base URL resolved first,
# which is the poller's job, not this function's.
/relative/path
article.html
../up-one-level

# No scheme.
example.com/article
//example.com/protocol-relative

# Schemes this archive does not fetch.
ftp://example.com/file
mailto:someone@example.com
javascript:alert(1)
data:text/html,<h1>hi</h1>
file:///etc/passwd

# No host.
https://
https:///path

# Empty and whitespace.


# A host that normalizes to nothing. Found by FuzzCanonicalize: this used to
# produce "http:///", a "canonical" form the function itself would reject.
http://.
http://..
https://.
